editorial:
You meet Nicky, a smooth con artist who teaches Jess the tricks of the trade, and their chemistry makes every scam feel like a game. The movie mixes romance, comedy, and crime, so you get slick heists, playful banter, and a stylish world where trust is always a trap. It moves quickly and keeps you guessing about who is really playing whom. You also see how Nicky's rules about never getting attached clash with his feelings, which gives the story some heart.

Will Smith and Margot Robbie carry the film with charm, and the set pieces are fun, though the plot can feel a little too clever for its own good. The tone stays breezy, so even the tense moments feel more playful than scary. If you want a light, stylish caper with romance, this is a good pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the sharpest picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Nicky's long con is revealed: he was never truly working for Garriga, and Jess's return was part of a bigger play to take the money and walk away together. After a tense standoff, Nicky and Jess escape with the cash, leaving Garriga furious and outsmarted. The last beat shows the pair driving off, proving their trust finally beat their old habit of running from love.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stylish con artist stories with romance.
